title: Tray Delete Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan for approval · design 1A from your phone test · issue #219 (tray delete) and its two steps, #220 (ask before deleting) and #221 (check and hand back)

short.lead: This builds the design you approved (answer 1A, "Ask first"). Delete under a thought in the tray opens a card that asks before anything is removed. I will put it on the build branch for pull request #209 (the calm build), and your phone test link will show the change once I have pushed it there.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it does.
items: The app already shows a confirmation card before it moves a task that is linked to GitHub. That card gets a 'Delete' button for deleting a thought. Only the Delete button removes the thought. Cancel, the Escape key and tapping outside the card all keep it. Deleting a task keeps the question it already asks.

items.alt: A card asking Delete Get three quotes for fixing the shed door, with Cancel and Delete buttons
items.caption: What step 1 builds.

items: Check it and hand it back (#221)

The tray's browser check presses Cancel first and expects the thought to stay in the tray, then presses Delete and expects it to be gone. After that I rerun all the automatic checks, update the docs and the quality-check page, and move the tray delete issue (#219) and its two steps (#220 and #221) to 'needs review'.
The build starts once you send the reply below.
Reply "Build plan approved: tray delete", or say what to change.
